{
  "candidate": "cand_0003",
  "headline": "Attack the one real mechanism behind every observed 4/5 — an unresolved defect-class minor in the terminal re-review — with a structural consistency script at the producer and reviser, producer-side rules for the three known AC/boundary defect classes, a narrowing rule that stops the re-review from escalating already-surfaced health warnings, and a reviser must-fix discriminator calibrated against every observed minor.",
  "clusters": [
    {
      "id": "A",
      "name": "unresolved defect-class minor in terminal re-review -> judge 4/5",
      "detail": "The external judge (decomposition_quality, rubric: '4 = one minor gap') reads the pipeline's final adversarial review; every observed 4/5 cites a defect-class minor left unresolved in that file, and every observed 5/5 had a clean or observation-only final review. The loop ends at pass:true (minors never fail), so defects the first review misses, the reviser leaves, or the re-review newly finds are never fixed. Sub-classes: A1 mermaid/frontmatter edge mismatch (cand_0002-019 first review; seed-018 post-decompose true positive); A2 parallel-supplier AC-precision gap (cand_0002-019 re-review: stub fixture covers only one launch path); A3 re-review escalating already-surfaced health warnings into Completeness minors (cand_0002-013 regression); A4 spec-vs-content overlap (seed-019); A5 rollout-gate AC gap (seed-019); A6 reviser leaves prescriptive minors unfixed (seed-019: all three stayed).",
      "tasks": ["case-019-content-vs-code-split"],
      "scope": "BOUNDED",
      "latent": false,
      "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"
    },
    {
      "id": "B",
      "name": "latent: reviewer pedantry draw on passing tasks (cand_0002's 013 break)",
      "detail": "cand_0002 broke case-013 (1.0 -> 0.75) via three Completeness minors that appeared only in the re-review, each mirroring a health warning the decomposer had already surfaced ('Flagged in Health Warning #N; Confirm with the strategy author'). The seed-013 run had the same health warnings, a clean review, and 5/5 — the delta is the reviewer/re-review draw, plausibly amplified by cand_0002's reviewer pattern-naming edits. This cluster is the regression mechanism this iteration's reviewer edit (A3 narrowing) is designed to close.",
      "tasks": ["case-013-human-process-gates"],
      "scope": "WIDESPREAD",
      "latent": true,
      "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"
    }
  ],
  "edits": [

    },

  "techniques": [

    "cross-candidate artifact diffing (seed vs accepted-for-019 vs rejected) to isolate what a 5/5 looks like",
